name: Foundation complete
objective: Establish formalism, card libraries, operator algebra, grammar layers, diagnostics, and transformer interface skeleton.
deliverables: formal docs; schemas; Batch01/Batch02; diagnostic graph; validator loops
exit_criteria: tests pass locally; diagnostic registry has no blockers; fallback manifests exist

name: Roadmap and governance correction
objective: Replace obsolete v0.7 roadmap with staged plan including NOEMA-first routing and GGUF teacher-validator policy.
deliverables: updated docs/11 roadmap; NOEMA/GGUF roadmap doc; roadmap JSON/YAML/CSV; roadmap module/tests
exit_criteria: roadmap schema exists; stage plan validates; repo clearly states GGUF is advisory only

name: NOEMA Retrieval and Inference Gate
objective: Route prompts to relevant concept/operator/event-frame subgraphs before any model call.
deliverables: noema index schema; routing policy; inference gate policy; energy estimator skeleton
exit_criteria: local decision can choose no_model/small_model/gguf_validator; routing decisions are auditable

name: GGUF Teacher-Validator Learning Loop
objective: Use GGUF/LLM only as advisory validator during learning and hard-case review.
deliverables: teacher verdict schema; verdict fusion; confidence policy; human review hooks
exit_criteria: GGUF verdict cannot set canonical alone; conflict produces unresolved/needs_review rather than overwrite

name: CIELingo Validator Hardening
objective: Promote validator from file tests to semantic quality gate for cards, relations, scope, cases, and event frames.
deliverables: quality statuses; blocker/warn/conflict registry; semantic invariant test suite
exit_criteria: validator can reject false equivalences for scope, case, and operator duals

name: Batch03 Controlled Expansion
objective: Add next 20 concept cards x 5 languages using strengthened validators and dependency reports.
deliverables: Batch03 cards; relation graph delta; heatmaps; martini-effect dependency report
exit_criteria: no blockers; new cards compared against previous 72 cards; all unresolved issues explicit

name: Transformer Adapter Experiments
objective: Test CIEL feature tensors as auxiliary signals, attention bias, adapter features, or validator constraints.
deliverables: feature tensor dataset; attention bias experiments; auxiliary loss prototypes; evaluation report
exit_criteria: measurable improvement on selected invariant tests or clear negative result

name: Benchmark and Public Draft
objective: Prepare technical spec draft, demo cases, reproducibility pack, and benchmark tasks.
deliverables: spec draft; demo notebook/CLI; benchmark suite; reproducibility checklist
exit_criteria: external reviewer can run tests and inspect claims without private context
